about: The masters reference set (board task gen-masters): the levels the generator's targets come from. The 22 main levels are the main structural targets (closest to what we make). The 4 levels below, from knowledge/levels/top100_gdtoday_2023.json (pre-2.2), were approved by the user on 2026-11-28 for general taste and light structuring only: 'i would use them more for some general taste and slight structuring. the hard demons are a bit far from us though'. So: learn their sync, pacing, mood and how sections change, never copy their density or difficulty. Dropped from the proposal: Change of Scene, CastleMania, B, DeCode, X, Bloodbath.
